svg.title: What happens in one session?
svg.desc: You talk to an AI agent session in natural language. At the start of every session the agent loads AGENTS.md, the rule file, with the kb/LOAD.md router, and reads your memory files: notes, the session log, the plan and the inbox. It works in your project folders, which stay where they are and are named by where: lines. During the session it appends one log block and proposes plan items marked [?]. It ends each answer with the EM line: what it used, what it found, what it changed and what waits on you. Nothing becomes permanent until you approve a commit, whoever executes it, which ratifies this folder.

rect.data-composition-frame-label: This folder — plain files, versioned by your commits

path.data-edge-label: ends each answer with the EM line
